What Our SVIPs Say
🌴 FAQ 🌴
Please contact customer service if you cannot find the answer you are looking for here.
What can I do with SeaArt?
SeaArt.AI is an art creation platform that offers unlimited creative potential for everyone! No professional skills are required to use SeaArt. Simply describe the image you want to create, and our system will use its extensive model library and professional settings to quickly generate high-quality images that fully meet your personalized needs. SeaArt will become your endless source of inspiration, powerful artistic partner, and efficient design tool. You will be creating the most creative images with minimal effort. SeaArt can also provide a variety of visual materials to make your content more attractive, or transform into your innovative art lab, allowing you to explore the integration of AI and art, stimulating innovative thinking.
Who is SeaArt suitable for?
No matter you are a beginner or a professional, you can find your exclusive drawing style and unique artistic expression in SeaArt.
Do I own the copyright to the work I created? Can I use the images that I create on SeaArt or other people's works on SeaArt for commercial purposes?
The intellectual property rights of the content generated by you on SeaArt belong to you, and we do not prohibit you from using your own or others' works for commercial purposes. However, please note that when using others' works for commercial purposes, you need to obtain authorization from the owners. We are not responsible for any risks associated with commercial use, and you need to assume the relevant risks and responsibilities on your own.
Does SeaArt provide features such as Model Merging and LoRA Training?
SeaArt's LoRA Training feature is available to all users, and Credits will be deducted based on the complexity and duration of the training. We will open the Model Merging feature in a future version, so stay tuned!
Can I sell my artworks or models?
All users can enable payment option for their artworks, models, or LoRAs!
How many devices can I use to access my account at the same time?
You can log into your SeaArt account on up to 3 devices at the same time.
How many works can I create using SeaArt per day?
Free users receive 130 Stamina per day, which allows for approximately 21 image creations. The daily Stamina granted to SVIP users corresponds to their respective tier and does not stack with the 130 Stamina granted to free users. Beginner Plan SVIP users receive 300 Stamina per day, allowing approximately 50 image creations; Standard Plan SVIP users receive 700 Stamina per day, allowing approximately 117 image creations; Professional Plan SVIP users receive 2,100 Stamina per day, allowing approximately 350 image creations; Master Plan SVIP users receive 3,500, 7,000, 12,000, 25,000, 50,000, or 100,000 Stamina per day depending on the tier purchased, allowing approximately 583, 1,167, 2,000, 4,167, 8,333, or 16,667 image creations. When both Stamina and Credits are exhausted, or the remaining amount is insufficient to support a single creation, further creation will not be possible.
How many artworks can I create simultaneously?
Regular users can process 2 tasks simultaneously. For more concurrent tasks, please upgrade to SVIP! Beginner Plan SVIP users can process 5 tasks simultaneously, Standard Plan SVIP users can process 10 tasks, Professional Plan SVIP users can process 15 tasks, and Master Plan SVIP users can process 20 tasks. SVIP comes with a wide range of privileges. Upgrade now to unlock more features!
What are SeaArt's generation cost rules and token rules?
SeaArt.AI has two types of tokens: Credits and Stamina. Stamina works like Credits but is only valid for the current day. Using image creation as an example, most models consume 6 Credits to generate a standard image. SeaArt has a vast collection of image/video creation models; please refer to the page display for the actual cost.
How can I get tokens in SeaArt?
You can claim 0 Stamina for daily login. You can also directly purchase Credits or subscribe to get a large amount of Stamina daily.
What services can I access by becoming a SeaArt VIP?
As a SeaArt VIP, you will get a large number of Stamina daily, permission to handle more tasks simultaneously, faster processing speeds, and more exclusive VIP features!
Do the Subscription Plan prices include taxes? Can I get an invoice? Why is the actual payment price inconsistent with the display on the website?
SeaArt.AI's SVIP plan pricing does not include tax. If you need an invoice, please go to Mall > Purchase Record > Obtain Invoice, select the corresponding purchase record, and submit your invoicing information as instructed on the page. The prices displayed in the Mall are estimated prices; due to exchange rate fluctuations, please refer to the actual payment.
Can I cancel my purchased Subscription Plan?
After you purchase a SVIP Plan through subscription and wish to cancel, you can manage this on the Subscription Management section of the Mall page. Once your subscription is canceled, no automatic charges will be applied at the onset of the next billing cycle, and your SVIP benefits will remain active until the end of the current subscription period.
When will I be charged after starting the trial?
You will be charged after the 3-day trial. However, due to regional differences and network latency, the charge may be processed a few hours earlier. Therefore, to ensure timely cancellation, we recommend canceling your subscription at least one day in advance.
Note: If you do not cancel the trial within the specified time and the charge is successfully processed, SeaArt will not provide a refund. Please refer to the Terms of Service for details.
Why can't I use my payment method?
We are actively integrating more localized payment methods to provide a more convenient payment experience. If you have specific payment method requirements, feel free to provide feedback through customer service, and we will prioritize and implement them as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience!
Why was my payment successful, but the order was not delivered?
Due to reasons such as network delays, occasionally, payments may not be delivered promptly. Please provide the following information, and we will process it for you immediately:
• User ID: [Your User ID]
• Order Number: [Payment Order Number]
We promise to process it within 24 hours. For urgent matters, please contact customer service directly!
Why does Stamina reset daily and cannot be accumulated?
SeaArt has two token systems:
• Stamina: Automatically replenished daily, valid for the day only, non-cumulative.
• Credits:
- Event Credits: Obtained through platform rewards, community events, or tasks.
Obtained before April 1, 2026: Never expire.
Obtained on or after April 1, 2026: Valid for 90 days to 2 years from the date of acquisition (the final validity period is subject to the specific event page and notification rules).
- Purchased Credits: Obtained through the purchase of Credit Packs, Super Value Packs, or Boxes.
Purchased before April 1, 2026: Never expire.
Purchased on or after April 1, 2026: Valid for 2 years from the date of purchase.
Both types of Credits can be accumulated.
💡 Tip:
- After Stamina is depleted, you can purchase Credits from the Mall to continue creating.
